responsibility: Declares the public RTL CFG-construction helpers from `cfgbuild.cc`. It exposes predicates for classifying RTL insns with respect to basic-block membership and control-flow termination, the routine for creating EH edges during RTL CFG construction, and the entry point for rescanning and splitting many sub-basic-blocks after RTL mutations have introduced new labels or branches inside existing blocks.
same_name_distinction: Declares the small exported interface for RTL CFG building and rescanning helpers such as insn classifiers, EH-edge creation, and sub-basic-block discovery; unlike gcc/cfgbuild.cc, it is only the header for those RTL construction routines.
